commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+3' Declan Rice (Arsenal) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+3' Emile Smith Rowe (Arsenal) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom right corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Jorginho comes off the pitch to be replaced by Mohamed Elneny (Arsenal).
87' Jorginho (Arsenal) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
86' Jorginho (Arsenal) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

65' 3 - 0 Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Loris Karius is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 3:0.
64' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Alexander Isak walks off the pitch to be replaced by Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd).
64' Eddie Howe has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) replacing Miguel Almiron.
64' Here comes a substitution. Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) is brought on as a substitute for Gabriel Martinelli.

62' A brilliant individual effort! Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) tricks his way past challenges into the box and blazes his shot just a few inches over the top. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
59' Jorginho (Arsenal) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Paul Tierney has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
58' Great teamplay by Arsenal as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
56' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
54' Jorginho (Arsenal) sends a long ball forward to Jakub Kiwior, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball has crossed the sideline. Newcastle are taking a throw-in.
53' The referee blows his whistle as Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) was too aggressive in his challenge.
51' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
49' Some great play by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) ends with a shot on the edge of the box low towards the middle of the net, but David Raya sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
47' Gabriel Martinelli provides the assist in the box, but Kai Havertz (Arsenal) places his shot a fraction wide of the right post.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

43' Handball! A player from Arsenal handled the ball.
43' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Arsenal.
40' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) commits a rough challenge and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
39' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

39' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) produced a promising shot towards the right side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Loris Karius thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Arsenal.
36' The ball rebounds to Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
35' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

31' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) who loops his header high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
30' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) was too forceful with his tackle and Paul Tierney interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
30' Arsenal are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player. The percentage of ball possession is – 72:28.
27' The corner from Declan Rice (Arsenal) is intercepted by Loris Karius.
27' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Arsenal are awarded a corner kick.
24' 2 - 0 Kai Havertz (Arsenal) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Gabriel Martinelli, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low shot into the middle of the goal. He makes it 2:0.
22' Ben White (Arsenal) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

18' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
17' Jorginho (Arsenal) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Arsenal get a corner.
15' Arsenal enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
12' Jorginho (Arsenal) commits a rough foul. Paul Tierney stops the game and makes a call.
9' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
7' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
5' Arsenal control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
3' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is penalised for a foul. Paul Tierney had a clear view and blows his whistle.

2' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
2' The referee awards a corner and Declan Rice (Arsenal) goes over to take it.
